bugbush.note: bug bushes: near-infinite food (instead of farms)

field.note: a farm's crops: the farm's food is pooled over its tiles (one farm, one amount); worked out it lies fallow until reseeded

paddy.note: an amphibian farm in the shallows: rice in the water; pooled like a field; worked out it lies fallow until reseeded

reeds.note: blocks movement; 100 wood per tile; becomes grass when cut down

rubble.note: walkable ground where stone was mined

shallows.note: shallow water: amphibians wade it (and may build on it, milestone 6), flyers cross it, others go round

stone.note: a stone deposit: 350 stone per tile; becomes rubble when mined out

swamp.note: walkable; amphibious races get a speed bonus here (milestone 6, movement classes)

water.note: impassable until there are boats (never, probably)

fallow.note: a worked-out farm: bare furrows, waiting to be reseeded

fallow_paddy.note: a worked-out paddy: muddy water, waiting to be reseeded
